title: ImageNet-Think-250K: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Multimodal Reasoning for Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitatively acknowledged as a representational limitation inherited from the source ImageNet-21k dataset, which may influence visual content representation, though it is not empirically measured.

Qualitatively discussed as a limitation, noting that the generated reasoning patterns primarily reflect English-language analytical frameworks and may not capture diverse cultural reasoning approaches.

Qualitatively identified as model-specific biases inherited from the source VLMs used for annotation, where architectural choices (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts) and training data methodologies (e.g., RLCS) influence and skew the style of generated reasoning patterns.
